name: City of the Deceased
description:
The then-lords of Gurabad regarded death as the only path to the desert's sacred destination. In order to prevent the wretched from defiling this pilgrimage, they buried the unnamed tomb deep underground...
But now, this place has become nothing but a paradise for Wenut and Fungi.

tabs.name: Suspiration of the Deceased
tabs.description:
The halls of death do not welcome the deluge of living things.
Walk through the winding corridors to clean up the overpopulating Fungi and slimes, along with those hilichurls who should not have occupied the place to start with. Perhaps such offerings will lead to unexpected rewards?
